name: The Shot That Ends the Conversation

description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger A creature you can see begins to Cast a Spell, Sustain an effect, or take an action with an audible verbal component.

Make a ranged Strike against the triggering creature. On a hit it must succeed at a flat check of DC 5 plus the damage dealt, halved, or the action is disrupted and lost. On a critical hit the action is disrupted with no check, and the creature cannot attempt that same action again until the end of its next turn.
